# Memos

Memos is an open-source, self-hosted note-taking app that brings your everyday thoughts together in a personal timeline. Your data stays yours, and you choose what to keep private or share.

## What it is

**What it is:** A lightweight, self-hosted note-taking app: short Markdown notes on a personal timeline, with tags, attachments and per-note visibility (private, workspace or public).

**Sub-tags:** notes (docs/design/TAXONOMY.md §1).

**Icon:** `icon.svg` is a neutral generated initials icon, not the upstream logo.

## How it is packaged

- **Image:** upstream `ghcr.io/usememos/memos:26.11.0` (the same index digest as `docker.io/neosmemo/memos`). The image creates the user `nonroot` (UID/GID 10001) and its entrypoint switches to it only when started as root (`scripts/entrypoint.sh`); this package starts as 10001 directly.
- **State:** PVC `memos-data` (2 Gi) on `/var/opt/memos`: the SQLite database and local attachments.
- **Health:** startup, readiness and liveness probes on `GET /healthz`, which answers 200 only while the database answers (`server/server.go`).
- **Security:** `runAsNonRoot`, `allowPrivilegeEscalation: false`, all Linux capabilities dropped, `RuntimeDefault` seccomp, no service-account token. One replica with the `Recreate` strategy, so two pods never write the same volume.

## First run

From the upstream documentation, https://github.com/usememos/memos/tree/26.11.0/docs:

1. Open the web UI (port 5230) from the OneMind dashboard.
2. Sign up. The first account becomes the instance administrator (host).
3. Under **Settings → System**, decide whether others may sign up.

## Known limits in this package

- S3 attachment storage and SSO are configured inside Memos, not by this package.
